publication_recovery_invariant.problem_class: A signed recovery artifact is not usable merely because it exists. The actual updater consumer path, manifest role, mutable pointer state, cloud asset/deployment semantics, and rollback of that publication layer must all be proven before diagnostic install.
mandatory_before_diagnostic_install: exact current cloud deployment/version identity captured
exact diagnostic manifest available at the URL/role the updater will actually consume
exact recovery manifest available at the URL/role the updater will actually consume
diagnostic -> recovery pointer/role transition proven without reconstructing or dropping unrelated production assets
exact prior cloud VERSION restoration to 100% proven; historical deployment ID reuse is not required because provider rollback creates a new deployment object
actual updater readback confirms each expected role/identity before device mutation

reconstructing a live asset set during an incident
weakening updater role/signature/hash checks to force recovery
installing a diagnostic before recovery publication mechanics are rehearsed

current_known_process_defect.symptom: seq20 Release07 recovery rejected with confirmed-release-role-changed
current_known_process_defect.root_cause: Updater is pinned to latest.json. latest.json remained seq19 role=update while exact signed seq20 role=recovery was separately published as recovery.json. The recovery artifact itself is valid, but the consumer/publication contract was never proven end-to-end before seq19 install.
current_known_process_defect.current_cloud_blocker: Version URL for candidate e4d31b2b-a9c1-4797-b5df-b8ad0121df6d returned HTTP 403 / Cloudflare 1010. This is not irreducible: Cloudflare officially supports smoke-testing a candidate in a split deployment at 0% traffic with the exact current stable version at 100%, then targeting only verification requests with Cloudflare-Workers-Version-Overrides.
current_known_process_defect.required_resolution_standard: Run one zero-normal-traffic rehearsal: stable version 29bdcc12-17ce-4feb-bb9e-e83cec5e1567 at 100%, candidate e4d31b2b-a9c1-4797-b5df-b8ad0121df6d at 0%, verify candidate through Cloudflare-Workers-Version-Overrides on the production route, then rollback exact stable VERSION to 100%. Only after this passes may the bounded seq20 recovery transaction proceed.
